name: erm
description: Write research with an elephant. Referee it with a goldfish.

interface.shortDescription: Draft research with context, referee it cold
interface.longDescription: Take scientific work from research question to submission-ready manuscript. A context-rich agent (the elephant) brainstorms, drafts protocols and manuscripts with you; fresh reviewers with no memory of the conversation (goldfish) referee the document cold, checking scope, comprehension, methods, evaluation, claims, reproducibility, citations and figures. You decide on every finding. Reviews require isolated sub-agents.
capabilities: Referee a manuscript with fresh reviewers
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this research idea into a focused question and hypotheses.
Referee this manuscript before I submit it.
Check that my manuscript still matches my results.
